verdict.rationale: The README documents one-line installs: `npx skills add yylo-dev/yylo-skills`, a single-skill variant with `--skill`, and `yy skills install`, which updates all three agent copies. A plugin/marketplace manifest also exists. The evidence never states that installed skills are active in the next agent session, and there is no hands-on confirmation that the install works. missing for 10: explicit documentation that skills load automatically in the next session, an exact in-agent marketplace install command, independent or hands-on corroboration of the install flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install a skill collection with one documented command — a package-manager one-liner, CLI, or in-agent marketplace command — and it is active in my next session

citations.quote: Install interactively with the open `skills` CLI: npx skills add yylo-dev/yylo-skills
Run `yy skills install` or `yy skills update` explicitly to select the latest compatible stable release and update all three agent copies.
The repository also exposes one plugin containing all eight canonical skills
